findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (final House vote, 66 aye, 47 no)
findings.note: Her recorded vote on the bill's second reading was No. The staff summaries say the ratified bill would require the voter registration application to affirmatively state US citizenship (with a penalty-of-perjury form if left blank), use federal data to remove non-citizens and deceased voters from the rolls, and have DMV share full social security numbers with the State Board of Elections. The bill has no photo-ID or mail-ballot ID section in the summaries.

findings.note: Her recorded vote on the motion to concur with the Senate version was No. The bill was ratified on August 6, 2026 and vetoed by the Governor on August 17, 2026, per the legislative staff summary at https://dashboard.ncleg.gov/api/Services/BillSummary/2025/H958-SMCH-69(rat)-v-6.
